test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 46

questions.question: Kajal and Shrishti run a race of 1 km, and Kajal wins by 50 seconds. Kajal and Sujata run the same race, and Kajal wins by 550 metres. When Shrishti and Sujata run the same distance, Shrishti wins by 60 seconds. What is the time (in seconds) taken by Kajal to run the distance of 1 km?5579
